title: POST /api/v1/clusters/{cluster}/objects/{name}/blocks: result
description: A block placed on an object's addresses, answered in the same call (outcome done, or partial where an address was left out or a node did not take it).

block_for.description: Value. How long a new block lasts, as the object writes it (such as 2h) or the engine's default.

blocked.description: Value. The addresses at least one node took, each written as the nodes write it.

refused.description: The addresses left out of the request, with why.

address.description: Value. The address as it was sent.

code.description: Code. address_exempt: the object exempts it and never blocks it. address_invalid: it is not an IP address.

reason.description: Text. The sentence that goes with the code.

nodes.description: What each node of the cluster said.

outcome.description: Code. done: the node holds every address blocked. refused: the node runs no blocking for the object yet. failed: the node did not take every address, or could not be reached.

message.description: Text. Why the node did not take them; null where it did, and for a token below the write level.

addresses.description: Each address the node was asked to block.

outcome.description: Code. done: the node reads it back as blocked. failed: it does not.
